title: 5-HT2A receptors in layer 5 pyramidal neurons mediate the neuroplastic but not the hallucinogenic effects of psilocybin
title_zh: 5-羟色胺2A受体在层5锥体神经元中介致塑性而非致幻的裸盖菇素效应
abstract: It is unclear how serotonin 2A receptors (5-HT2ARs) in cortical layer 5 pyramidal neurons differentially contribute to psilocybin-induced hallucinations versus neuroplasticity. Here we show that psilocybin promotes synapse formation and maturation while accelerating the elimination of pre-existing synapses. Cell type-specific manipulation further demonstrated that 5-HT2AR signaling in cortical layer 5 pyramidal neurons is necessary and sufficient for psilocybin-induced synaptic remodeling but dispensable for the head-twitch response, a rodent proxy of hallucination.
abstract_zh: 人们不清楚皮层层5锥体神经元中的5-羟色胺2A受体如何区分裸盖菇素诱导的幻觉与神经可塑性。本研究表明，裸盖菇素促进突触形成和成熟，同时加速先前突触的消除。细胞类型特异性操作进一步表明，5-羟色胺2A受体在层5锥体神经元中的信号传导对于裸盖菇素诱导的突触重塑是必要且充分的，但对啮齿类头抽动反应（即幻觉的啮齿类模型）是可 dispensable 的。
